title: NetworkDockTimerRequest
description: network.dock-timer-request@1: the body of PUT /api/v1/people/:subject/dock/timer on OpenVibe.Network (network.dock.timer.write): a first-party service sets or clears ONE person's Dock timer. { minutes } starts one (1 to 180 minutes), { clear: true } stops it. The service writes the timer and nothing else: the rest of the person's Dock state is never touched.

minutes.description: How long the timer runs, in minutes.

kind.description: A plain timer (the default), or a focus block, which alternates a focus round and a break by itself.

label.description: What it is for, in the person's own words.

rounds.description: How many focus rounds in all (a focus timer only; 4 by default).

clear.description: true stops the timer: there is none afterwards.
